confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Hong Kong price levels for July 2026, not live listings. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable; hostel and hotel rates vary widely by district and season, so treat them as bounded estimates. Cocktail and wine are cross-checked against the beer anchor rather than verified directly. The FX value was taken from web-search summaries citing rba.gov.au; the RBA table itself was not opened, and one summary flagged its column matching as uncertain, so verify the 14 Oct 2026 figure before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; based on general knowledge of Hong Kong's own price levels across restaurant, bar, hostel and hotel tiers. No live listings or booking pages were checked.
